levels: Compliance gate and product exam passed. Allowed to represent the products.

rubric: Opens warmly, asks about severity and duration, one question at a time
Names the problem back in one genuine sentence and checks it
Asks what has been tried and always asks about medication
Short bridge, outcome-led, honest recommendation of the right products
One genuine reinforcing line, then receive method first
Steers every message to a next step without pressure
Safe language, doctor referral where needed, and treats the customer as a health journey, never a one-off sale
redflags: Claims to cure, treat, prevent or reverse a disease
Diagnoses a customer or names a disease as their condition
Suggests stopping, pausing or replacing prescribed medication
Says clinical studies prove the product works
Invents a testimonial, statistic or credential
Ignores a serious symptom and does not suggest seeing a doctor
Uses pressure or false urgency to close
Shares a customer's details or story without consent
